line.name: H. Upmann 1844 Classic
line.description: Not on the site. Released 2021 by Altadis USA as part of the '1844' portfolio (named for H. Upmann's 1844 founding year), positioned as a tribute to the brand's Cuban heritage. Medium-bodied; notes of leather, nutmeg, spice, coffee, toast, sweet cream. FLAG: vitola list is single-sourced to JR Cigars - not independently cross-verified against a second retailer in this research pass.
